thresholds.description: LOW: probability < 0.080; MEDIUM: 0.080 <= probability < 0.120; HIGH: probability >= 0.120

LOW.operational_intent: Standard automated dispatch to van; unattended delivery authorized without dispatcher intervention.

MEDIUM.operational_intent: Proactive customer digital engagement; trigger SMS delivery window confirmation, availability check, and access code collection.

HIGH.operational_intent: Pre-dispatch mitigation; reroute to Amazon Locker / Access Point, hold for evening dispatch shift, or prompt customer for mandatory alternative.

LOW.default_details: Normal dispatch to van; unattended delivery authorized to designated drop point.

MEDIUM.default_details: Trigger automated customer SMS delivery notice to confirm recipient availability.

HIGH.default_details: Recommend pre-dispatch rerouting to nearby Amazon Locker / Access Point for secure autonomous pickup.

calibration.justification: Additional parametric scaling or isotonic regression was omitted because unweighted Logistic Regression probabilities are already naturally aligned with empirical failure frequencies across all validation deciles.

explanation_rules.PREFERENCE_DEPARTURE_MISMATCH: preference_departure_mismatch == 1 or customer_delivery_preference mismatch with departure_hour/weekend

audit_and_compliance.synthetic_target_disclaimer: The target 'first_attempt_failed' and CRM features were synthetically generated for hackathon prototype evaluation. Operational thresholds are derived from validation set experiments and do not reflect real-world Amazon logistics performance.
